claims.text: Play through five chapters. Make separate manual saves at the beginning and end of each chapter.
Take the Chapter 1 balcony meditation before moving on.
Continue in free roam and use the checklist to guide robberies, exploration and activities.
Work toward 70 Challenges. The 50-Challenge trophy unlocks on the way.
Close out eight qualifying stranger strands and the trophies still open after the checklist.
The platinum is awarded after you earn the other trophies.

missable.text: Potentially missable in Chapter 1. After Down to Earth, follow Lucia to the balcony at Jason’s house in the morning and accept. Make a manual save before continuing.

steps28.text: After Down to Earth, find Lucia at Jason’s house in the morning.
Follow her to the balcony and accept before Chapter 1 ends.
Finish each meditation sequence and check Progress › Collections › Exploration › Meditations.

intro.text: After the story, open Progress › Stats › 100% Completion. The checklist requires a subset of the world’s objectives.

partial.text: 15 / 18 card sets · the trophy needs three

full.text: 39 Gang Operations, 22 Bank Jobs, 7 Payday Loan Jobs and 8 bank vaults
33 underwater discoveries, 42 shooting range golds and 42 drone trials

other.text: Also listed by KeenGamer: story, 100 optional tasks, fencing targets, Kenton treasure sets, books and magazines, meditations, playlists, styles, weapons, race wins and golds, arcade games, pool, mini golf, basketball and 300 stunts.

watch.text: Mission replay is unavailable. Use separate manual saves at each chapter’s start and end.
Cheats disable trophies and saving while active.
Use Lucia for Andy and Jason for Tyrone and Bret. Hourglass-marked quests can expire and do not count toward the trophy.
The Irredeemable profile choice is irreversible.
